Text label drawn at the mic.bull panel's angle-90 position (where microphone_vertical_orientation = 90, i.e. straight up). Text label drawn at the mic.bull panel's angle-270 position (where microphone_vertical_orientation = 270, i.e. straight down) - rendered at the LEFT of the plot as of Josh's ninth follow-up (2026-09-15), which reverted this panel's coord_polar to the standard start=0 mapping used by every other panel (the eighth follow-up had it at the bottom instead). See @details "mic.bull panel".

Font size of each panel's own title (pt) - the REQUESTED size. Per Josh's seventeenth follow-up (2026-09-16, "have the titles all reduce in size so that they don't run together"), if the actual panel titles wouldn't fit at this size given the current auto.scale/subplot.size.width, ALL panel titles are shrunk together (down to an 8pt floor) to fit before the figure is ever widened - see @details, "Title auto-shrink (with width auto-expand as a fallback)". So the rendered title size may be smaller than this value for narrow panels/long titles; it is never larger.

Row left in place for backward compatibility - harmless if present, simply ignored.

Color of the MAJOR angular gridlines only now (the N-S/E-W cross lines, panel.grid.major.x) - the 25/50/75/100 radial rings are no longer drawn via panel.grid.major.y (blanked) and are instead an explicit black/dashed geom_hline layer, see scale.line.* below and @details "Scale lines"/"Draw order". Line type of the 25/50/75/100 scale-line rings - solid, per Josh's follow-up (2026-09-14, fourth round): "make the bulls eye plot scale lines solid" (reverses the third round's "dashed" request).
